author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell reacts to AfD leader Alice Weidel and Germany’s renewed debate over nationalism, borders and immigration. After joking that even fairly ordinary political arguments can sound terrifying when delivered in German, he compares today’s rhetoric with the country’s history and asks how far nationalist politics can go before things begin to spiral.

title: Is this the change Germany needs?

author: Russell Brand
description:
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has her eyes on the trillions Europeans have sitting in their bank accounts. Describing household savings as money that needs to be put to work, Brussels wants to channel more of it into the European economy. Russell asks the obvious question: when did the money you worked for, saved and deliberately kept safe become something the EU believes it should have plans for?

title: They never thought we'd find out...

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell's guest Sonia Elijah breaks down the Center for Countering Digital Hate, a British and American NGO she calls the ideological engine behind mass censorship, working alongside the Biden administration and big tech to silence dissenting voices. She points to their 2021 Disinformation Dozen report, which claimed just twelve people, including RFK Jr., were responsible for 65 percent of all anti vax sentiment online, before revealing leaked documents showing the group's stated top priority was killing Elon Musk's Twitter, using coordinated advertising boycotts to try to strangle the platform financially. A sharp, well documented breakdown of the actual machinery behind online censorship.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell meets Rick, owner of Emerald Coast Zoo, who explains why he sold his house and bought a zoo instead. The conversation quickly moves from animals to theology, including a surprising discussion about the serpent in John 3:14 and its connection to Christ. Then things get chaotic when Rick decides to put a live alligator around Russell’s neck. Faith, theology, wildlife and Russell trying not to get clawed — all in one conversation.
